name: Monopoly Harry Potter — House Cup
theme: House points and exploring the castle
tagline: The Hasbro box: no money, no bankruptcy.
summary: Pick your house, explore the castle with your points, place your crests. The game ends when the last location is explored — highest total wins.

factions.label: Your house
factions.prompt: The Sorting Hat sends you to…

cards.hibou-01: Correct answer in Transfiguration: your house gains 20 points.
cards.hibou-02: You catch the Golden Snitch at practice: 50 house points.
cards.hibou-03: You win a duelling practice: 30 house points.
cards.hibou-04: Professor Flitwick rewards your charm: 10 points.
cards.hibou-05: Return to GO and collect your 20 points for passing.
cards.hibou-06: Thestral flight: go to the Room of Requirement.
cards.hibou-07: Alohomora — the door gives way: advance to the Chamber of Secrets.
cards.hibou-08: Accio! The Knight Bus carries you off.
cards.hibou-09: You are excused from detention. Keep this card until needed.
cards.hibou-10: Tea at Hagrid's: go to his hut.
cards.hibou-11: You get lost on the staircases: go back three spaces.
cards.hibou-12: The Hogwarts Express whistles: board the nearest magical transport.
cards.hibou-13: A spell sweeps you to the nearest magical service. Throw the dice again and pay ten times the amount.
cards.hibou-14: Common room party: collect 10 points from every player.
cards.hibou-15: You help a classmate in Potions: 20 house points.
cards.hibou-16: Excellence in Defence Against the Dark Arts: 40 points.
cards.hibou-18: The Sorting Hat whispers advice: go to the Great Hall.
cards.hibou-19: Professor McGonagall praises your work: 30 points.
cards.hibou-20: You are excused from detention. Keep this card until needed.
cards.hibou-21: An owl brings you a Honeydukes parcel: 15 points.
cards.hibou-24: You break a rare phial: pay 25 points per crest placed.
cards.hibou-25: Upkeep of the places you explored: pay 40 points per crest.
cards.hibou-26: You hand out Chocolate Frogs: pay 10 points to every player.
cards.hibou-27: Go to The Leaky Cauldron for a Butterbeer.
cards.beuglante-01: HOWLER! Your parents heard about the flying car: 40 points lost.
cards.beuglante-02: HOWLER! Snape takes 30 house points from you.
cards.beuglante-03: HOWLER! Filch caught you in the corridors at night: go to detention.
cards.beuglante-04: HOWLER! Summoned at once: off to detention.
cards.beuglante-05: HOWLER! Compulsory contribution to Hogwarts' reserve: 25 points.
